stages.headline: A polygon is convex if it lies on one side of every line containing one of its sides.
stages.headlineEnglish: A polygon is convex if it lies on one side of every line containing one of its sides.

stages.headline: The angles of a convex n-gon add up to (n − 2) · 180°; diagonals split it into n − 2 triangles.
stages.headlineEnglish: The angles of a convex n-gon add up to (n − 2) · 180°; diagonals split it into n − 2 triangles.

stages.headline: The exterior angles of a convex polygon (one at each vertex) always add up to 360°.
stages.headlineEnglish: The exterior angles of a convex polygon (one at each vertex) always add up to 360°.
